setlist_extra.title: That's It For The Other One

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Death Don't Have No Mercy** (2 reviews): Reviewer points to this song as the one to hear, with Phil's bass standing out; Reviewer hears a particularly tragic version of this song [7][12]
- **Turn on Your Lovelight** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out the Lovelight as the show's standout, deserving top marks by itself; About 15 minutes long, with Pigpen and Jerry going at each other [4][14]
- **Clementine** (1 review): Reviewer regards this Clementine as the best they can recall [11]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): Short version where Jerry plays at a pace not sustainable in longer ones; reviewer feels it's all Jerry [12]

## The recordings

- **gd69-01-26.sbd.kaplan.2246.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 11 songs; 79 min; rated 4.48/5 by 25 [1]. Said about its sound: Lacks the high-end distortion or crunchiness heard on other recordings from the same period; The mix fluctuates wildly for a couple of minutes at the start before settling; Sound quality problems at the beginning of the recording [3][4][5][7][11][12]
- **gd1969-01-26.sbd.miller.109642.flac16**: soundboard; 7 songs; 79 min; rated 4.5/5 by 14 [2]. Said about its sound: Mix problems at the start of the show, and a reel flip during Dark Star [2]

## Around the show

- Sons of Champlin and Initial Shock were also on the bill [2]
- The Eleven > Lovelight from this date also appeared on the album Live Dead [1]
- Reviewer prefers the earlier Clementines to this one [5]
- The Eleven > Lovelight here is the pairing released on Live Dead [5]
- Reviewer has heard other shows from this period with more power [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-01-26.sbd.kaplan.2246.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Seth Kaplan; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Dark Star has a splice at 8:12, resuming just before the second verse; the first Cryptical Envelopment got soundboard adjustments; Some files were not cut on sector boundaries; they were repaired with shntool and given a new md5 file (12/14/00) [1]
- **gd1969-01-26.sbd.miller.109642.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k) [2]. Also: Source is a soundboard transfer made from DATs lent by Rob Eaton [2]

## Art and photos

- Photo by Zoooma (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead poster for 1/24, 1/25, 1/26/69 Avalon Ballroom, San Francisco borrowed from www.deadlists.com](https://www.flickr.com/photos/9692677@N07/3223348712/) [16]
